_comment: Shared SPEC-023 §3.3.1 rule 9 rate-global rounding vectors. ONE source of truth consumed by scripts/tests/test_catalog_artifact_feed.py (catalog_release.scaled_nonnegative_integer, the release gate) and phase4-coordinator/internal/billing/rate_global_rounding_cases_test.go (billing.ParseShareBps / billing.ParseMultiplierPPM, what settlement actually computes). Every value is parsed as a binary64 by both readers and scaled by the same binary64 scale, so a case pins the PRODUCT's rounding, not the operator's decimal intent. The cases flagged decimal_divergence are the ones that matter: their shortest decimal text lands exactly on a half unit while the binary64 product does not, so a decimal-semantics port answers one unit higher than the coordinator. Adding a case here binds both sides; changing either implementation alone turns one of them red instead of shipping a signed rate card the coordinator never derives.

shares.note: product is at or above the half unit; ties-to-even would give 0
product falls just BELOW 1.5 bps; decimal ROUND_HALF_UP gives 2
product is at or above 2.5 bps; ties-to-even would give 2
product falls just BELOW 14.5 bps; decimal ROUND_HALF_UP gives 15
many-digit share above the half unit
production share nudged onto a half unit
rounds up to the full share

multipliers.note: product is at or above 0.5 ppm; ties-to-even would give 0
product is at or above 2.5 ppm; ties-to-even would give 2
product falls just BELOW 1000002.5 ppm; decimal ROUND_HALF_UP gives 1000003
product falls just BELOW 1000007.5 ppm; decimal ROUND_HALF_UP gives 1000008
many-digit multiplier above the half unit
